name: Stack & Sigil
summary:
Stack & Sigil is a block-stacking roguelike where you compete against others on a global high-score leaderboard.

Taking inspiration from Tetris and adding a lot of extra flavour and flair, Stack & Sigil provides players with powerful relics, unique set abilities and endless difficulty.

Currently in Public Playtest v1.0, the game already boasts 1v1 duels, leaderboards, and an endless roguelike mode - if you're brave enough!
